title: Open Studio Residencies
host_org: Snow Farm: The New England Craft Program
source_quote: In July and September, we offer small group residencies that allow 3 or 4 artists in each of the offered studios to pursue their own projects or practice with the support of Snow Farm housing and meals.
evidence_sentence: Open studio residencies in July and September give artists access to all studios including ceramics with its raku kiln and pit firing area.
evidence_quote: upgraded electricity for the outdoor kiln deck which includes a raku kiln, Bailey gas kiln, and pit firing area
summary: Small-group open studio residencies in July and September allow resident artists to work in the ceramics studio with access to raku, gas reduction, and pit firing.
